questions.question: Is this private research, public analytics, paid recommendations or wagering operations?
questions.known: The request is research/decision support and a public GitHub Pages site.
questions.missing: Jurisdiction, audience, monetization and whether stakes are handled.
questions.discovery: Default to analytics-only; obtain qualified legal review before any paid or wagering feature.

questions.question: Which spreads, totals, moneylines, team totals and player props are in scope?
questions.known: Singles, parlays and player-prop combinations are requested.
questions.missing: Exact market definitions, books, overtime/void/push rules and prop settlement.
questions.discovery: Create a market dictionary from permissioned book rules and official NFL scoring rules.

questions.question: Which provider permits historical and live odds retention, derived models and redistribution?
questions.known: NFL widgets display partner-supplied odds; no licensed archive is verified here.
questions.missing: Contract, API terms, latency, limits, prop coverage and retention rights.
questions.discovery: Request written vendor terms; compare coverage and cost without assuming access.

questions.question: What authoritative machine-readable source settles every target and market?
questions.known: NFL publishes scores, stats and season-specific rules.
questions.missing: Licensed export, correction policy and market-specific grading map.
questions.discovery: Map NFL game/player identifiers to book market IDs and test settlement on known cases.

questions.question: Can every feature be reconstructed as it was known before kickoff?
questions.known: Current injury pages and club depth charts are mutable.
questions.missing: Immutable snapshots, publication times, correction history and as-of joins.
questions.discovery: Capture raw-source hashes and timestamps on a schedule; never backfill from future pages.

questions.question: Which depth charts are official guidance, unofficial lists or confirmed lineups?
questions.known: Commanders/Giants publish club depth pages; Colts explicitly labels its Week 10 chart unofficial.
questions.missing: Confirmed starters, game-day actives and actual replacement participation.
questions.discovery: Store source authority separately; join inactive lists and participation only when verified.

questions.question: How much does a specific replacement change expected performance?
questions.known: Depth order alone does not measure quality or workload.
questions.missing: Role-specific snaps, opponent-adjusted outcomes and enough replacement cases.
questions.discovery: Estimate effects from verified historical participation with uncertainty; abstain when sparse.

questions.question: How should Questionable, Doubtful, Out and blank status be encoded?
questions.known: NFL policy defines the labels; blank game status is not a probability.
questions.missing: Empirical availability calibration by status, timing and team.
questions.discovery: Keep categorical labels; estimate probabilities only from point-in-time training data.

questions.question: What happens when NFL.com, a club chart and a news article disagree?
questions.known: Week 10 sources show status/depth lags and missing players.
questions.missing: A reconciled, timestamped authority policy.
questions.discovery: Preserve both observations, flag the conflict and suppress affected model inputs.

questions.question: What model family and uncertainty method produce the independent number?
questions.known: A transparent baseline plus opponent/context adjustments is testable; no family is validated.
questions.missing: Verified training sample, feature definitions, calibration and holdout results.
questions.discovery: Pre-register a simple baseline first; expand only if held-out skill improves.

questions.question: Which leg pairs are dependent and how stable is the dependence?
questions.known: Same-game outcomes can share game script; no verified correlation value is available.
questions.missing: Matched binary leg outcomes, joint events, sample counts and conditional groups.
questions.discovery: Estimate phi/Pearson association and direct joint probability on training games; bootstrap by game.

questions.question: Can joint probability and payout be verified without an independence shortcut?
questions.known: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid when legs are dependent.
questions.missing: Book combo price, void rules, joint settlement and held-out joint calibration.
questions.discovery: Price from validated joint outcomes; compare with independence baseline and reject sparse pairs.

questions.question: Are prop lines, participation and settlement available at the decision timestamp?
questions.known: NFL tracking glossary defines useful metrics but is not a prop feed.
questions.missing: Historical prop quotes, player IDs, minutes/snaps, void rules and book coverage.
questions.discovery: Secure permissioned prop history and official participation labels before modeling.

questions.question: What minimum evidence is required before a strategy is eligible?
questions.known: Thresholds must be declared before viewing results; this site proposes conservative design defaults.
questions.missing: Owner-approved sample, risk, calibration and shadow policy.
questions.discovery: Use the published proposed gates as research defaults; do not claim they are league rules.

questions.question: How many strategies and feature variants were tried?
questions.known: Leaderboard selection inflates apparent performance.
questions.missing: Complete trial registry including failed and abandoned variants.
questions.discovery: Hash pre-registrations and apply family-wise multiplicity control before ranking.

questions.question: Can luck be removed from the evaluation?
questions.known: No. Randomness remains; uncertainty can be quantified and false confidence reduced.
questions.answer: Luck cannot be eliminated; require out-of-sample, uncertainty-aware evidence.
questions.missing: Prospective verified forecast record and stable benchmark improvement.
questions.discovery: Use proper scores, game-cluster intervals, ablations and shadow follow-up.

questions.question: What score determines the winner?
questions.known: Raw win rate and short-run ROI are inadequate.
questions.missing: Approved scoring rule, benchmark, stake policy and minimum activity.
questions.discovery: Propose benchmark-relative Brier skill with uncertainty and gate eligibility; keep divisions separate.

questions.question: Who funds rewards and what legal rules apply?
questions.known: No reward pool, payment system or legal approval is verified.
questions.missing: Budget, eligibility, tax/legal review and dispute process.
questions.discovery: Publish recognition-only leaderboard until funding and compliance are confirmed.

questions.question: Can ingestion run without manual entry and survive source changes?
questions.known: GitHub Actions can schedule captures and build static pages; Pages has no backend database.
questions.missing: Durable history storage, alerting, rights and source SLA.
questions.discovery: Use scheduled official captures with hashes; add durable storage only after retention review.

questions.question: Are nflverse release assets official NFL data?
questions.known: They are community-maintained GitHub releases; a digest proves byte integrity, not NFL authorship.
questions.answer: No official NFL authority is established for those assets in this review.
questions.missing: NFL endorsement/license or row-level official confirmation.
questions.discovery: Label community outputs exploratory/unverified and exclude them from official-only gates.

questions.question: How are suggestions approved without accidental deployment?
questions.known: The suggestion board can record optional browser-local choices and export JSON.
questions.missing: Server-side identity, durable approvals and change-control integration.
questions.discovery: Treat exports as review artifacts; require a separate tracked change before implementation.

questions.question: Will accounts, payments or sensitive betting activity be collected?
questions.known: This site is static and collects no account or wagering data.
questions.missing: Future product scope and privacy/legal requirements.
questions.discovery: Keep data minimization; threat-model any future backend before adding it.

suggestions.title: Adopt an official-only evidence contract
suggestions.detail: Separate source authority, byte integrity and model validation. Community data may be exploratory only; canonical decision values require official confirmation.
suggestions.tradeoff: Some existing exploratory numbers become non-decision evidence.

suggestions.title: Secure permissioned odds and prop history
suggestions.detail: Obtain written terms for historical/live prices, limits, timestamps, props, retention and derived data.
suggestions.tradeoff: Cost and vendor selection remain unresolved; do not scrape around rights.

suggestions.title: Build immutable official availability snapshots
suggestions.detail: Scheduled capture of NFL injury reports, club depth pages and inactive evidence with raw hashes, timestamps and conflict flags.
suggestions.tradeoff: Public pages can change or block automation; durable storage needs review.

suggestions.title: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
suggestions.impact: Creates a clean benchmark before complexity
suggestions.detail: Pre-register a simple team-strength model, freeze versions and record forecasts before kickoff.
suggestions.tradeoff: No immediate betting recommendations or rewards.

suggestions.title: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties
suggestions.impact: Tests whether personnel information adds skill
suggestions.detail: Compare identical models with and without verified availability features using chronological holdouts.
suggestions.tradeoff: Sparse replacement cases may force abstention.

suggestions.title: Delay parlays until joint outcomes validate
suggestions.detail: Require matched leg outcomes, direct joint calibration, game-cluster uncertainty and book payout rules.
suggestions.tradeoff: Slower expansion into requested combo markets.

suggestions.title: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions
suggestions.detail: Separate singles, game parlays, same-game parlays and prop combos; rank eligible strategies by benchmark-relative skill with uncertainty.
suggestions.tradeoff: Requires minimum sample and complete trial registry.

suggestions.title: Keep rewards recognition-only until approved
suggestions.detail: No money, credits or stake handling until budget, jurisdiction and legal review are verified.

suggestions.title: Publish a conflict-aware review queue
suggestions.detail: Flag source lags, authority gaps, missing ranks and unsupported claims with official links and discovery actions.
suggestions.tradeoff: Flags do not block publication but block affected decisions.

suggestions.title: Automate build, citation and link gates
suggestions.detail: Fail CI on missing row sources, broken local links, duplicate IDs, conflict markers or unsupported verified badges.
suggestions.tradeoff: External content still needs scheduled re-verification.

suggestions.title: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
suggestions.detail: Store immutable captures outside the static site, monitor freshness and alert on source/schema changes.
suggestions.tradeoff: Hosting, retention and access controls need a decision.

suggestions.title: Expand to player-prop combinations last
suggestions.impact: Addresses the hardest requested market safely
suggestions.detail: Require verified participation, prop settlement, joint dependence and held-out calibration before any combo signal.
suggestions.tradeoff: Highest data and overfit burden; no launch date is promised.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
strategies.hypothesis: Rolling offense/defense efficiency with opponent and context adjustments improves spread/total forecasts versus a simple baseline.
strategies.inputs: Official game outcomes, possessions/context, as-of features and permissioned prices.
strategies.test: Walk-forward by game; compare Brier/log loss and calibration against frozen baseline and market.
strategies.risk: Schedule strength, garbage time and small samples.

strategies.name: Quarterback availability shock
strategies.hypothesis: Confirmed QB absence/replacement changes team scoring enough to create incremental forecast value.
strategies.inputs: Timestamped injury/inactive evidence, confirmed replacement, historical participation and prices.
strategies.test: Ablate availability feature; cluster uncertainty by game; require held-out improvement.
strategies.risk: Status is not playing probability; replacement quality varies.

strategies.name: Offensive-line replacement stress
strategies.hypothesis: Multiple verified OL replacements degrade protection/run efficiency beyond what the market prices.
strategies.inputs: Position-specific depth, actives, snaps, pressure/sack outcomes and market prices.
strategies.test: Role-weighted exposure model versus unweighted injury count; chronological holdout.
strategies.risk: String rank alone is not a deficiency estimate.

strategies.name: Secondary replacement exposure
strategies.hypothesis: Verified defensive-back replacements affect passing efficiency and scoring conditional on coverage role.
strategies.inputs: Depth/actives, participation, opponent-adjusted passing outcomes and prices.
strategies.test: Compare defense-exposure feature ablation with game-cluster intervals.
strategies.risk: Rotation and scheme confounding; sparse cases.

strategies.name: Pace and possession efficiency
strategies.hypothesis: Neutral pace and points-per-possession improve total forecasts over raw points per game.
strategies.inputs: Official play/context data or licensed verified equivalents; prices and settlement.
strategies.test: Pre-registered total model; held-out calibration and market comparison.
strategies.risk: Pace and efficiency can be endogenous to score script.

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay value
strategies.hypothesis: Only combinations with verified joint pricing and demonstrated dependence treatment may have value.
strategies.inputs: Timestamped combo prices, leg outcomes, void/push rules and joint sample.
strategies.test: Direct joint probability versus independence baseline; held-out joint Brier score.
strategies.risk: Cross-game independence is an assumption, not a verified fact.

strategies.name: Same-game script combination
strategies.hypothesis: Game-script-linked legs require conditional joint modeling rather than multiplying marginals.
strategies.inputs: Matched same-game leg outcomes, combo payout rules and prices.
strategies.test: Estimate dependence on training games; validate joint calibration and payout EV out of sample.
strategies.risk: Strong dependence, sparse combos and book margin.

strategies.name: Receiver opportunity prop
strategies.hypothesis: Verified target-share/air-yard changes under personnel shifts may improve reception/yardage forecasts.
strategies.inputs: NGS definitions, licensed tracking/participation, prop quotes and settlement.
strategies.test: Player-grouped chronological validation; compare with book-implied probability.
strategies.risk: Role changes, coverage and void rules.

strategies.name: Rushing workload prop combo
strategies.hypothesis: Confirmed replacement workload and game script may jointly affect rushing attempts/yards.
strategies.inputs: Depth/actives, snap counts, rush outcomes, prop lines and joint settlement.
strategies.test: Joint outcome model with game-cluster bootstrap and independence comparison.

strategies.name: Injury-news timing reaction
strategies.hypothesis: Forecasts updated only after verified status changes may beat stale baselines if execution is feasible.
strategies.inputs: Immutable report timestamps, quote timestamps, latency/limits and settlement.
strategies.test: Event-time study with no future information; execution-cost stress test.
strategies.risk: Market may react first; stale or revised reports cause leakage.

gates.name: Official provenance
gates.rule: Every decision input has an official source URL, retrieval time, raw hash and field-level confirmation; community data is excluded from official-only claims.
gates.fail: Missing authority, hash mismatch or inferred value.

gates.name: As-of integrity
gates.rule: Feature availability and quote timestamps precede forecast time; forecast precedes kickoff; training games end before holdout games.
gates.fail: Future information, overlapping game clusters or retrospective edits.

gates.name: Completeness
gates.rule: Required fields, identifiers, coverage and duplicate checks pass; unknown cells remain blank and flagged.
gates.fail: Silent imputation, duplicate events or missing settlement.

gates.name: Market executability
gates.rule: Permissioned timestamped price, limits/latency, vig, push/void and settlement rules are documented.
gates.fail: No actionable price or unverifiable grading.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Model version, feature set, thresholds, benchmark and complete trial family are hashed before evaluation.
gates.fail: Post-hoc rule changes or hidden failed trials.

gates.name: Out-of-sample skill
gates.rule: Walk-forward proper-score improvement over a frozen baseline survives game-cluster uncertainty and multiplicity adjustment.
gates.fail: Uncertainty includes no improvement, or evidence disappears in untouched holdout.

gates.name: Dependence / combos
gates.rule: Matched joint outcomes validate direct joint probability and dependence against an independence baseline.
gates.fail: Sparse pairs, marginal-only pricing or test-set correlation fitting.

gates.name: Personnel robustness
gates.rule: Availability features use dated official/club evidence with authority labels; conflicts or stale sources trigger abstention.
gates.fail: Depth rank inferred from injury listing or fixed unsupported penalty.

gates.name: Prospective shadow
gates.rule: Frozen forecasts are logged before outcomes and monitored for drift, calibration and freshness.
gates.fail: No independent prospective record or changed rules after seeing results.

gates.name: Reward eligibility
gates.rule: Only strategies passing G01-G09 enter a division leaderboard; rewards require approved funding and legal policy.
gates.fail: Raw win-rate ranking, lucky streak reward or unresolved dispute.

flags.title: NFL authority is unverified for GitHub-hosted data
flags.finding: Repository code describes nflverse GitHub release assets as official NFL data. The local manifest checks GitHub-published SHA-256 digests, which confirms byte integrity only; this review did not find NFL authorship or authorization evidence. This is not a finding that the data are inaccurate.
flags.action: Treat these outputs as authority-unverified and exploratory; exclude them from official-only gates/rewards unless NFL provenance and data-use permission are independently confirmed.

flags.title: No verified historical odds/prop archive
flags.finding: NFL Support confirms partner-supplied widgets, not a licensed historical feed or settlement archive.
flags.action: Obtain permissioned market history before CLV, ROI or parlay EV claims.

flags.title: Depth charts are not confirmed participation
flags.finding: Club charts can be unofficial or lag injury reports; Colts explicitly labels its Week 10 chart unofficial.
flags.action: Keep authority, rank, active status and workload separate; blank missing fields.

flags.title: Injury source lags and conflicts
flags.finding: NFL.com report/article and club depth pages can disagree on availability or listed players.
flags.action: Preserve both timestamps and flag conflicts; suppress affected signals.

flags.title: No empirical correlation or validated strategy
flags.finding: Canonical official-only matched leg outcomes and prospective records are absent; correlation and performance cells are blank.
flags.action: Run the documented protocol only after data gates pass.

flags.title: Luck cannot be eliminated
flags.finding: Residual variance contains chance, opponent effects and model error; it is not a pure luck estimate.
flags.action: Use uncertainty, ablations, multiplicity control and shadow validation; avoid certainty claims.

flags.title: Rewards lack funding and legal approval
flags.finding: No reward pool, jurisdiction analysis or payment compliance is verified.
flags.action: Recognition-only until approved; no stake handling.

flags.title: Static hosting has no durable backend
flags.finding: GitHub Pages serves static files; scheduled Actions are not a guaranteed real-time database or alerting service.
flags.action: Use immutable captures and add durable storage/alerting after retention review.

flags.title: Current report is not a historical archive
flags.finding: The Week 10 injury page changes and does not provide point-in-time reconstruction by itself.
flags.action: Store retrieval time and raw hash for every capture; never backfill from a later page.

flags.title: Review choices are browser-local
flags.finding: Suggestion selections/export do not create server-side approval or deploy changes.
flags.action: Use exported JSON as a review artifact and require a tracked implementation change.

flags.title: Parallel-session overlap and coordination noise
flags.finding: Multiple sessions began from the same empty baseline and produced overlapping dashboards; append-only logs preserve the history.
flags.action: Keep canonical decision tables here and preserve other workspaces as linked research archives.

flags.title: Official source links are not reuse permission
flags.finding: Public NFL/club pages establish facts for review but do not by themselves grant redistribution, API or commercial rights.
flags.action: Confirm terms before bulk republication or commercial automation.
